notes: Read all 220 source lines (numbered) before editing. The module is the RUM bootstrap: it stands up the OpenTelemetry *browser* SDK and ships browser spans (page loads, route changes, fetch/XHR) to the OTel collector over OTLP/HTTP. The SDK building blocks are browser-only and none of the `@opentelemetry/*` packages are bundled in apps/native (verified: no node_modules/@opentelemetry/*), so the construction cannot run under Hermes; the two explicit instrumentation helpers are generic logic needing only window/history + a Tracer. Ported behind native-safe globalThis facades + an explicit unavailable-state matrix per the safeUUID / notificationSound / InstallPrompt convention.

L1-23 header comment block (RUM purpose, ADR-008 single-import note, the four VITE_* config knobs + their defaults, the 'no tail sampler' note) -> carried into the native file header, expanded to document the browser-only SDK reality and the native-safe substitution strategy.

L25-35 the eight `@opentelemetry/*` imports (sdk-trace-web WebTracerProvider/BatchSpanProcessor, exporter-trace-otlp-http OTLPTraceExporter, context-zone ZoneContextManager, instrumentation registerInstrumentations, auto-instrumentations-web getWebAutoInstrumentations, resources resourceFromAttributes, semantic-conventions ATTR_SERVICE_NAME/ATTR_SERVICE_VERSION, api trace/SpanStatusCode/Tracer) are NOT importable (browser-only + not installed). Replaced with: locally-typed OTel-api facade interfaces (RumExceptionLike, RumSpan, RumTracer, RumTracerProvider) reached via globalThis; ATTR_SERVICE_NAME='service.name' and ATTR_SERVICE_VERSION='service.version' inlined verbatim; SpanStatusCode.ERROR inlined as `const RUM_SPAN_STATUS_ERROR = 2`; the Tracer type became the local RumTracer. No DOM/OTel/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI imports remain (the file has zero runtime imports).

''`.trim() (resolveRumEnv reads the injected `globalThis.TESLASYNC_RUM_ENV`, mirroring the api/client.ts globalThis-config precedent); the empty-endpoint branch keeps the exact `console.info('[rum] VITE_OTLP_HTTP_ENDPOINT not set; OpenTelemetry RUM disabled.')` guarded by `isDevEnvironment(env)` (web `import.meta.env.DEV`; native prefers env.DEV then falls back to the React Native `__DEV__` global probed off globalThis) and the early return.

'teslasync-web' (literal 'teslasync-web' default preserved for behavioural fidelity — the resource is only consumed by an injected provider and can be overridden via TESLASYNC_RUM_ENV); deployEnv = env.VITE_OTEL_DEPLOY_ENV ?? env.MODE ?? 'unknown'; serviceVersion = env.VITE_APP_VERSION ?? 'unknown'.

L64-77 `new WebTracerProvider({ resource: resourceFromAttributes({...}), spanProcessors:[ new BatchSpanProcessor(new OTLPTraceExporter({ url: endpoint }), { maxQueueSize:2048, maxExportBatchSize:512, scheduledDelayMillis:5000 }) ] })` is browser-only. Faithfully rebuilt as a RumTracingBackendConfig: the resource object keeps the same three computed keys ([ATTR_SERVICE_NAME], [ATTR_SERVICE_VERSION], 'deployment.environment.name'), the exporter `endpoint`, and the batch sizing {2048, 512, 5000} verbatim — then handed to bootstrapTracingBackend so NO configuration value is dropped (it is delegated to an injected provider's optional `bootstrap` hook; inert no-op otherwise — nativeRumCapabilities.otelWebSdkAvailable/otlpSpanExportAvailable=false).

Browser-only state made explicit: exported `nativeRumCapabilities` { otelWebSdkAvailable, fetchXhrAutoInstrumentationAvailable, historyRouteSpansAvailable, globalErrorSpansAvailable, otlpSpanExportAvailable } all false documents the pure-native reality (no OTel browser SDK, no DOM history/window). A host may inject globalThis.TESLASYNC_RUM_TRACER_PROVIDER (OTel-api-shaped) and globalThis.TESLASYNC_RUM_ENV to light up real span export + config on the react-native-web target, preserving genuine parity there. Public surface (initRum, installRouteSpanEmitter, installGlobalErrorRecorder) + all three state-flag names preserved.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit); npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
